# MoltSets

MoltSets provides people and company search, profile enrichment, email and mobile discovery, advertising identity resolution, and account usage data.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/moltsets/.

## Actions

- **Enrich LinkedIn Profile** (read-only): Resolve a LinkedIn profile URL into a sparse full person and company profile, optionally including experience.
- **Find Best Email by LinkedIn** (read-only): Find the best validated email for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100, preferring business email and falling back to sensitive…
- **Find Best US Personal Email by LinkedIn** (read-only): Find the highest-confidence validated sensitive personal email for one US LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100.
- **Find Business Email by LinkedIn** (read-only): Find a validated corporate email, without personal-email fallback, for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100.
- **Find Business Email by Name** (read-only): Find a validated business email and matched LinkedIn URL from a person's name and company/domain.
- **Find Business Profile by Name** (read-only): Find a sparse full person and company profile from a person's name and company or domain, optionally including experience.
- **Find Company by IP** (read-only): Resolve a B2B visitor IPv4 address to associated company domains and provider percentages.
- **Find Email Hashes by LinkedIn** (read-only): Retrieve sensitive ad-audience match keys for one LinkedIn profile URL or slug.
- **Find LinkedIn by Email** (read-only): Resolve one email address to the highest-confidence LinkedIn profile URL available from MoltSets.
- **Find LinkedIn Profile** (read-only): Find matching person or company LinkedIn profiles from a person's name and company/domain.
- **Find Mobile Advertising ID by Email** (read-only): Resolve one email address to at most one highly sensitive Mobile Advertising ID (MAID), such as an Android AAID or Apple IDFA, for…
- **Find Mobile Phone by LinkedIn** (read-only): Find sensitive carrier-verified mobile data for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100.
- **Find Personal Email Hash by Business Email** (read-only): Convert one business email into one sensitive SHA-256-hashed personal-email match key for customer-match and paid-advertising audiences.
- **Find US Personal Email by LinkedIn** (read-only): Find a validated sensitive personal email for one US LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Safely read the connected MoltSets account, plan capabilities, token and phone-token balances, and live Fair Use headroom before paid or…
- **Get Billing** (read-only): Get billing-sensitive plan and subscription dates, token balance, unlimited status, and per-tool token costs.
- **Get Usage** (read-only): Get daily and aggregate API calls, tokens, found-data, no-data, and failed counts for today, week, month, or the billing cycle.
- **Reverse Lookup Email** (read-only): Resolve one email or a batch of up to 100 into a sensitive sparse person and business profile, including company firmographics, LinkedIn…
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search ranked companies by name or domain, firmographics, industry, and location.
- **Search People** (read-only): Search ranked people and current companies with positive and exclusion filters.
